integrity: A symbolic uniform proof is supplied with an exhaustive finite standard-library checker for thirty parameter/precision cases. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes p and exponents 2p^s with s>=1 only; inputs constrained to consecutive integers. This is a local modular image/fiber theorem and does not count globally bounded integer solutions; possible implicit priority from general p-adic normal forms or inaccessible sources remains.
title: Exact odd-prime fibers of consecutive even prime-power sums
